raw_posts.name: Yoroll
raw_posts.tagline: Build playable stories without a game engine
raw_posts.description: Yoroll lets anyone turn stories into playable, cinematic games without coding or a game engine. Start with a script, image, or video clip, then direct the scenes, add player choices, and create branching storylines with different outcomes. AI helps bring everything together into an interactive experience you can share. It's more like directing your own interactive movie than programming a game.

raw_posts.name: Rankhog
raw_posts.tagline: Get customers from Reddit on autopilot
raw_posts.description: Rankhog finds people on Reddit asking for what you sell. It reads each subreddit's rules, writes a reply that helps, and posts it from your own account at a human pace. Say yes to each reply, or turn on autopilot. No Reddit account? Rankhog warms up a new one, and you own it. Run it from the app, or from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client. 7 days free.

raw_posts.name: Resurf
raw_posts.tagline: Personal Knowledge Base & Bookmark Manager for Mac
raw_posts.description: A fully local personal context library for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Save notes, links, images, and documents. Hand off context to AI through MCP or the CLI on Mac.

raw_posts.name: Daymaker
raw_posts.tagline: Gifts so personal, your prospects take the meeting.
raw_posts.description: Daymaker is known for coldcakes, that ends today. Daymaker is the tool that researches your prospects, finds out their interests, recommends a personalized gift, repackages it in your branding, and sends it to your prospect. Making sure you get your meeting. Want it done for you? We run the campaign and guarantee the meetings.

raw_posts.name: oovi
raw_posts.tagline: Your own team of AI on your desktop
raw_posts.description: Hand oovi a job and a team of AI bots does it: a leader plans, a researcher digs, a writer drafts, a critic checks. Watch each bot work, and approve anything before it goes out. Free with your own AI key, or from $10/mo with credits that never expire.

raw_posts.name: Creavit Studio 4.0
raw_posts.tagline: Screen recording, iPhone camera and cinematic demos for Mac
raw_posts.description: Plan, record and turn your screen into a product story. Creavit Studio 4.0 brings QR-paired iPhone portrait capture, camera takes added after recording, Content Planner, Standard and Liquid MultiFocus, cinematic 3D MacBook and iPhone scenes, Smooth Scroll, Smooth Typing, your voice in another language, and Auto FX with your approval at every stage. Built for Mac. Also available on iPhone for recording and editing on the go.

raw_posts.name: Webless Agents
raw_posts.tagline: Agents you want to put in front of customers
raw_posts.description: You wouldn’t put most website chatbots in front of a customer. Webless Agents are different: you describe the outcome you want in plain English, and Webless builds the agent on your published content, so it answers only from what you’ve said. You review every instruction and change anything before it goes live. Then it gets to work: answering questions, qualifying buyers, sending quotes, booking meetings and handing off to your team. For Product Hunt: 3 months of our highest plan, free.

raw_posts.name: Omi CLI
raw_posts.tagline: AI coding agents that work while you're away.
raw_posts.description: Omi can build anything. Give Omi a coding task and let it get to work: it reads your repo, fixes bugs, runs tests, and uses a real browser to check your app. Parallel subagents tackle tasks in separate worktrees. Background agents keep going after you close the terminal; cloud agents can open PRs. Review changes as diffs, undo mistakes, and choose from 13 models or bring your own. Free to start: npm i -g @builditomi/cli

raw_posts.name: Ulika
raw_posts.tagline: Visual editor for sites built with Claude, Cursor, or Codex
raw_posts.description: AI can ship a React, Vite, or Next site in a weekend. Then marketing wants a headline change and opens a ticket. Ulika connects the site so anyone can edit copy and images on the page and publish, without touching code. Open beta, free to try at ulika.co.

raw_posts.name: Mockreel
raw_posts.tagline: your screen recording, but in a 3D phone. free, no signup
raw_posts.description: ok so every time I launch an app I need one of those 3D phone videos, and every tool wants a download or a subscription. nope. built my own. you drop in a screen recording (or a screenshot, I don't judge), it shows up inside a 3D iPhone / MacBook / iPad / browser window, you pick a look, add a camera move, slap a headline on it, export MP4 up to 4K. runs in a browser tab. no upload, no signup, no watermark, no catch. it's free. go make your app look expensive.
